metadata.title: Glamour Portrait with Script and Sans-Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A full-body glamour portrait featuring a central subject in metallic attire against a neutral gradient background with layered script and sans-serif text.
excludeWhen: requesting dark or moody grunge styles

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length studio portrait of a woman in a gold sequined mini-dress, positioned to the left, set against a warm taupe gradient background featuring a large, faint calligraphic flourish and crisp white typography on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject offset to the left balanced by large-scale typography on the right
Warm metallic tones of the clothing harmonizing with the taupe background
Contrast between the organic curves of the script and the rigid lines of the sans-serif text
Soft studio lighting creating a glow on the subject's skin and sequins
coreInvariants: Layered typography with a large script initial

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject positioned in the left third of the frame, scaled to occupy the full vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large 'A' script flourish.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the body to the shoes, then sweeps right to the large script name and down to the subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the right side, occupied by a faint graphic flourish and text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold and bronze for the subject's attire and skin highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation background with high-value highlights on the subject and text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Elegant script paired with a condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script features long, sweeping swashes and varying stroke widths
Sans-serif is strictly geometric, tall, and thin
The initial letter of the script is oversized and acts as a graphic element
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended crossbar on the 'A' to create a decorative loop
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, feminine script and rigid, modern sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Large, low-opacity calligraphic flourish in the background

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, elegant script motion
Matches the condensed, clean sans-serif subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body studio portrait of a woman in a gold sequined dress against a taupe gradient background. Include a very faint, large-scale abstract line flourish on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a large white script font on the right side, and a subtitle in a thin, condensed white sans-serif font directly below it.

verificationChecks: Is the subject positioned to the left?
Is the primary text a white script?
Is the background a warm taupe gradient?
Is there a secondary condensed sans-serif line?

postGenerationChecks: Check for legibility of white text against the background
Ensure the gold sequins have a realistic metallic sheen
Verify the gradient transition is smooth without banding
Confirm the script font does not overlap the subject's face
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Metallic Wardrobe + Taupe Gradient + Script/Sans-Serif Typographic Lockup
